parallels.note: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

translations.web: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
translations.bsb: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
translations.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
translations.asv: And these in like manner are they that are sown upon the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, straightway receive it with joy;
